findings.description: Priority 1 recommendation: "Raise the contrast ratio of the flagged text…" lacks a specific selector, page URL or count from audit data.
Priority 2 recommendation: "Add descriptive alt text to every informative image…" is generic and not anchored to any specific element or page.
Priority 3 recommendation: "Give every custom control an accessible name…" does not reference a particular control, selector or count from the audit.
Priority 4 recommendation: "Expose the structure a sighted user sees…" is generic and not tied to any specific markup instance.
Priority 5 recommendation: "Add a skip link as the first focusable element…" lacks a page or selector reference.
Priority 6 recommendation: "Order headings without skipping levels…" is not anchored to any specific heading hierarchy instance.
Priority 7 recommendation: "Replace the obvious landmark containers…" does not specify which elements or pages need changes.
Priority 8 recommendation: "Add the missing response headers at the server or CDN edge…" is a generic statement without specific header names or affected URLs.
Priority 9 recommendation: "Add the missing required and recommended Schema.org properties…" does not reference any particular entity, property or page from the audit data.
